question: Why can student not search Cloud courses (Connection lost) in UntisX (endpoint /admin-panel)?
answer: Check role student. Module Cloud courses may require higher permissions. Error Connection lost: on 401/403 check credentials and tab permissions, on 404 check the route in App.tsx/AppNavigation.kt, on 500 check server logs and database, on timeout check the Docker container and network. Validate endpoint /admin-panel and the database connection. Feature Realtime must be enabled.
